brief: Replacement directions for parent Tincta and Rewards artwork; black and white; avatar legibility; keep Morph and Assembly as positive references. No production changes or deployment.

prompts.name: Incision
prompts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand / abstract generative artwork sketch.
Asset type: black-and-white visual-identity artwork for Tincta, a research and onchain publishing studio. This is an exploratory art sketch intended both as a website illustration and as an X account avatar.
Create ONE original abstract geometric artwork on a pure white square canvas, straight-on. Rich but disciplined construction, mathematical precision, clear black-and-white negative space, exceptionally clean vector-like edges. Flat black ink and white only; no colors, tonal shading, gradients, shadows, paper texture, lighting, photography, mockup or background decoration. Grayscale edge antialiasing is acceptable. Keep all artwork comfortably inside an imaginary central circular safe area occupying 80% of the square, with generous white margins; do not draw the circle. The silhouette must remain recognizable when reduced, without relying on text.
The existing admired Tincta Morph art uses nested square contours whose corners progressively round while rotating, and Tincta Assembly uses a logical grid of curved/rectilinear modules. Take their principle of a simple rule producing an unexpected shape; create a DIFFERENT construction. Be more authored and particular than a standard spirograph.
Avoid repeated ellipses, toruses, central ring-shaped holes, generic rosettes, infinity signs, coins, stars/sparkles, hexagons, familiar crypto symbols, mascots, letters, monograms, any text, labels, numbers, watermarks or logos. Do not include multiple proposals or a presentation board. One substantial, composed, visually memorable artwork only.
Specific direction A, INCISION: an asymmetric compact monolith of 14 to 18 nested angular contour bands, with softened internal turns and a stepped outer silhouette. A single oblique white incision enters from the upper right and continues into an off-center interior elbow, so the form has a deliberate open seam rather than a circular hole. The contours behave like folded topographic strata: broad at one shoulder, compressed at another, with one small displaced lower ledge. Build a dense sculptural graphic from flat parallel black contour strokes with generous white spacing; a few black planes at the turning points give structural weight. Precise and editorial, neither a fingerprint nor a building icon. Strong silhouette, calm proportion, unexpected asymmetry. The main contour architecture must be clear with about 16 lines, not hundreds of hairlines.

Specific direction B, COUNTERFOLD: a single broad ribbon of 12 parallel black tracks turns through three unequal folded planes and crosses itself once. It should feel like a precisely constructed folded drawing whose volume comes only from line geometry, not shaded 3D rendering. Avoid an S logo, infinity loop, heart, pretzel or knot stock icon. One side extends into a crisp small shelf while the opposite side curls back in a shorter return; unequal proportions make the silhouette ownable. Fewer, firmer contour lines instead of fragile dense filigree.

Specific direction C, CELLWORK: a bold architectural cluster assembled from seven or eight interlocking black geometric cells on an underlying three-by-three grid. Each cell relates a straight edge to one smooth concave or convex edge, but DO NOT use the familiar repeated quarter-circle tile pattern. Adjacent cells cooperate to form a single continuous, asymmetric white channel that steps and bends through the black mass. Remove one corner and offset one small edge cell, giving a very specific outer silhouette. Mix two large black masses with smaller paired cells; avoid uniform tiles and avoid a checkerboard. This is an original abstract modular composition with tactile precision and strong figure/ground rhythm, expressive of collective construction. It should read as one remarkable artwork, not nine separate icons. Flat solid black and white, no outlines unless structurally necessary.

Specific direction D, BRANCHFORM: an abstract compact folded branching form made from about 12 parallel black contour tracks. The tracks emerge from a short broad base, split into three unequal angular lobes, and return along carefully curved inside corners. The highest lobe is a broad bent rectangular fan, the second is shorter and turned sideways, the third is a small counterweight. White channels separate the branches and remain open; a narrow diagonal break prevents the overall form from becoming symmetrical. It is a graphic study of growth under rules, not a literal tree, plant, antler, coral, hand or circuit-board icon. Keep a strongly authored angular outer contour and smooth inside turns. The silhouette should be sculptural, unusual and memorable, with enough solid black structure to survive an avatar reduction. No circular center, no radial flower.

refinements.prompt: Refine this black-and-white Counterfold sketch. Keep the precise flat parallel black-track construction and pure white background, but change the ribbon's overall trajectory so it no longer reads as a large letter S. Fold the long upper arm down and back behind the center, then shorten the lower arm into an offset angular return. Make the result a compact asymmetric three-plane woven object, with ONE clear over/under crossing and a generous white diagonal seam; no closed ring or infinity loop. The outer silhouette should be nearly as wide as tall and feel unusual, architectural and deliberate, not alphabetic. Use about 10 strong parallel tracks with clean white spacing. Keep every part comfortably inside the central circular safe area, approximately 72% of the square canvas. No text, labels, color, gray shading, texture, shadows, mockups or additional variants. Only the one refined artwork.

Create ONE new black-and-white abstract geometric art sketch for Tincta, a research and publishing studio. Square canvas, pure white background, black ink only, immaculate flat vector-like contours. No text, no logo, no gray shading, no gradient, no paper texture, no shadows or photographic treatment.
Direction: COUNTERFOLD. A compact folded structure built from 10 broad parallel black tracks. Two unequal bent planes interleave diagonally: a broad upper-left angular fan folds behind a narrow central bridge, which returns forward into a shorter lower-right fan. Make a clear over-under crossing with a wide white seam. The silhouette is a compact irregular polygon, nearly as wide as tall, with one clipped corner and one curved return. It is an intriguing folded geometric object, not a letter S, infinity sign, ring, bow, heart, bird, star or recognizable stock symbol. Let straight cut ends meet smooth inside turns. This should feel carefully designed and slightly surprising, related to the logic of nested transforming square frames but not copying that form. Firm black tracks and generous white spacing should read when reduced to an avatar. Center the complete compact artwork within an imaginary circle occupying 74% of the canvas. Do not draw a circle or frame. One standalone artwork only.
